_comment: UI-NFR-003 R-013/R-014/R-015/R-028 gzip budgets. initialJsGzipKb is a deliberate ceiling of 600 KB with headroom above the 2026-07-12 measured baseline (503.3 KB gzip). The dominant cost is the eagerly-loaded i18n translation bundle (~182 KB gzip), which grows with every feature's DE/EN copy. HARD RULE: when the measured initial JS reaches 600 KB, do NOT raise this budget again — an alternative solution MUST be implemented first, i.e. lazy-load the translations (splitting the eager i18n bundle) to move back toward the R-013 aspirational 300 KB gzip target. Raising the ceiling past 600 KB is prohibited; the next step at that point is the lazy-i18n refactor, not a bigger number.
